name: Clone Faker
description: A ninja move so fast that the user appears in three places at once.

name: Flurry Dash
description: Allows the user to run like the wind. Suited to the most agile players.

name: Whirlwind Twister
description: Spinning the ball makes a twister that confuses opponents.

name: Illusion Ball
description: This tricky move conjures up other balls, but which is real?

name: Dash Accelerator
description: Get a step ahead of an opponent with this super dribble move.

name: Rolling Hell
description: A rolling double tackle that makes its target feel like hell!

name: Heat Tackle
description: This hard hitting fiery tackle scorches nearby opponents!

name: Zigzag Spark
description: This zig-zag dribble shocks nearby opponents like lightning!

name: Rodeo Clown
description: Get past the other team with the speed of a clown dodging a bull.

name: Black Magic
description: Stops opponents in their tracks by enveloping them in a magic shadow.

name: Super Armadillo
description: This tackle surrounds the ball and hits like a rolling armadillo!

name: Poison Fog
description: Blow poison fog like a ninja, but don't breathe it in yourself!

name: Attack Scan
description: Get past opponents by reading their intentions with a brain scanner.

name: Bewildered
description: Confuse opponents by kicking up a cloud of dust.

name: Boost Glider
description: Get a speed boost from a friend and feel the power of cooperation.

name: Afterimage
description: Get past opponents by leaving an image for them to follow.

name: Mole Fake
description: Bypass opponents by making the ball tunnel like a mole!

name: Whirlwind Cut
description: Cut through opponents by wrapping yourself in a whirlwind!

name: Monkey Turn
description: Get past opponents with the agility of a monkey.

name: The Wall
description: This giant wall is created through the power of the earth.

name: Killer Slide
description: Steal the ball with a tackle so fast it looks like the user has many legs.

name: Coil Turn
description: Confuse opponents by spinning around them.

name: Earthquake
description: Make the ground shake by dropping right out of the sky!

name: Quick Draw
description: Get hold of the ball by moving faster than the eye can see.

name: Spider Web
description: Keep opponents wrapped up with these sticky spider threads!

name: Cyclone
description: Kick the ball and players into a spin with cyclone power!

name: Fake Ball
description: A sneaky move which swaps the real ball for a fake substitute.

name: Shadow Stitch
description: A shady ninja art that uses a player's shadow against them.

name: Sumo Stomp
description: Pound the ground just like a professional sumo wrestler.

name: Horn Train
description: No one can escape unharmed when this technique has its horns out.

name: Hurricane Arrows
description: Whip up a hurricane and send your opponents flying.

name: Spinning Cut
description: Roundhouse opponents off the ball with the power of the shockwave.

name: Defence Scan
description: Steal the ball by reading opponents' movements with a brain scanner.

name: Ghost Pull
description: There's no escaping these spooky hands which come out of the earth!

name: Doppelganger
description: This occult defence blocks an opponent with their body double!

name: Bamboo Pattern
description: Surrounds an attacker with three players for a triple tackle!

name: Harvest
description: A double tackle that cuts through everything like a scythe!

name: Divine Stamp
description: Summons a giant foot from above, flattening anything in its path!

name: Inazuma Drop
description: Uses a big partner as a stepping stone for a super high jump shot!

name: Dragon Crash
description: This big move needs a strong kick and appears as a flying blue dragon.

name: Twin Boost
description: Kicking the ball in tandem gives this move increased shot power.

name: Fire Tornado
description: This shot appears as an intense fireball from out of the sky.

name: Wrath Shot
description: This super aerial shot is made by kicking the ball like a machine gun.

name: Inazuma-1
description: This coordinated shot attests to the strength of friendship.

name: Grenade Shot
description: By twisting the body, this shot boasts the power of a grenade!

name: Death Zone
description: A super shot powered by three players in a deadly triangle.

name: Phantom Shot
description: This shot bewilders the keeper with a ball from the underworld.

name: Hawk Shot
description: This shot hits like a hawk diving from high in the sky.

name: Meteor Attack
description: The ball becomes a dazzling shooting star on its way to goal.

name: Snake Shot
description: This super drive shot unleashes the power of a coiled snake!

name: Spinning Shot
description: Shooting while spinning may make your head spin, but it's tops!

name: Comet Shot
description: A beautiful shot which heads to goal followed by a comet's tail.

name: Rolling Kick
description: A twisting aerial move that fires up a mighty shot.

name: Clone Shot
description: A ninja move where the user splits and shoots from any direction.

name: Dynamite Shot
description: A shot from the sky that explodes in the goal. It's dynamite!

name: Patriot Shot
description: Once kicked up, the ball becomes a missile that's a real rocket!

name: Spiral Shot
description: This shot spirals at the goal while spinning on two different axes!

name: Freeze Shot
description: This shot does as it says and puts a chill on everything it touches.

name: Tornado Catch
description: This takes the wind out of a shot by putting an anticyclone on it!

name: God Hand
description: Through guts and spirit, this huge right hand should stop any shot!

name: Power Shield
description: No matter where the ball goes, this move has got it covered.

name: Fireball Knuckle
description: This special flaming punch requires a manly fist!

name: Shot Pocket
description: A barrier extends from both arms, swallowing up opponents' shots.

name: Warp Space
description: Can anything avoid getting sucked into this black hole?

name: Counter Strike
description: Turn the game around by scoring from the other end of the pitch!

name: Sliding Goal
description: Could it be a miracle save or a specially made moveable goal?

name: Triple Defence
description: Everyone works as one in this three man defensive wall.

name: Pressure Punch
description: This high speed punch is capable of crushing any shot.

name: Toughness Block
description: Stopping shots with a body of steel should get you out of a pinch.

name: Full Power Shield
description: This shield stops absolutely anything thrown at it!

name: Wood Chopper
description: Cuts any shot into pieces like a lumberjack to a tree.

name: Whirlwind
description: Swallow up shots with whirlwinds emitted from both hands.

name: Rocket Kobushi
description: Let fly a flaming fist and beat down shots with a rocket punch!

name: Wild Claw
description: Catch shots with this running jump that is out of the wild!

name: Gigant Wall
description: The power is gigantic! If nothing else, it's huge!

name: Mistral
description: The goal is protected from shots by swirling leaves.

name: Killer Blade
description: A right-handed move which cuts through shots like a samurai sword.

name: Tsunami Wall
description: Calls up a wall of water to drown out opponents' shots!

name: Blazing Knuckle
description: At 100 punches a second, it hits like a Gatling gun!

name: Majin The Hand
description: A crushed spirit summons up a demon invoking the legend of the Inazuma.

name: Infinite Wall
description: This legendary Farm Jr High move is football's best defence!

name: Cross Drive
description: Powered by combining horizontal and vertical strikes in a cross shot.

name: Teleport Shot
description: Where are both the ball and keeper taken? Do they really disappear?

name: Psycho Shot
description: This move uses telekinetic power to shoot the ball!

name: Condor Dive
description: This header is like a condor diving from high above.

name: Run Ball Run
description: Dash towards the goal by running on the ball!

name: Triangle Z
description: This three-man co-op shot draws a shape in the air like the letter Z.

name: Utter Gutsiness Bat
description: Wind up a team-mate at full swing to get a home run blaster!

name: Reflect Buster
description: This shot reflects off floating fragments of the pitch!

name: Kung Fu Header
description: This super header uses real kung fu power!

name: Shine Drive
description: This shot shines like the sun, blinding anyone too close.

name: Divine Arrows
description: By powering up with multiple kicks, this shot pierces like an arrow!

name: Back Tornado
description: Another aerial spinning move! Can it match the Fire Tornado?

name: Tarzan Kick
description: Swing from the vines with this groovy jungle shot.

name: God Knows
description: This super move lifts you up on the wings of an angel.

name: Dragon Tornado
description: This move needs perfect timing to unleash the power of the dragon!

name: Dirt Ball
description: As the amount of earth around the ball increases, so does the power!

name: Fire Rooster
description: Combines the power of two good friends to make a fiery bird!

name: Inazuma Break
description: The ultimate exploding shot made by giving it everything all at once!

name: The Galaxy
description: An unbelievable shot that is totally out of this world!

name: Emperor Penguin No.2
description: The cute name belies the power of this penguin projectile!

name: Heaven's Time
description: Walk elegantly past any opponent by stopping time itself!

name: Breakthrough
description: Kick any opponent through the ball. Good kids don't do this!

name: Dash Storm
description: Blow away an opponent with wind power. Will we see him again?

name: Moonsault
description: Fly over opponents' heads with ease like a gymnast!

name: Magic
description: The secret trick to moving in this illusion is a trade secret.

name: The Phoenix
description: Three players running together produces a phoenix from the flames!

name: Baby Dragon
description: He might be cute, but this baby dragon has a shot like lightning!

name: Dark Tornado
description: This mysterious prohibited move burns up everything in black fire!

name: Inazuma Drop
description: This lightning shot requires a stout player to work with an agile buddy!

name: Inazuma Break
description: The ultimate exploding shot made by giving it everything all at once!

name: Mega Quake
description: A massive earthquake which sends everything skyward!

name: Blade Attack
description: A lightning blast which hits the ground and cuts through the earth.

name: About Face
description: A vicious knee kick from behind! (Come on, ref!)
